examples.text: uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, ko attho supitena vo, āturānañ'hi kā niddā, sallaviddhāna ruppataṃ.

64101.grammar: masc, agent, from supati, irreg, intrans
64101.notes: agent noun used verbally see Perniola §292

examples.text: abhijānāti kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo divā supitā'ti?

evam'āvuso'ti. tena hi tvaṃ, āvuso seyyasaka, yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñja yāva'd'atthaṃ supa yāva'd'atthaṃ nhāya. yāva'd'atthaṃ bhuñjitvā yāva'd'atthaṃ supitvā yāva'd'atthaṃ nhāyitvā yadā te anabhirati uppajjati rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti tadā hatthena upakkamitvā asuciṃ mocehī'ti.
sukhaṃ supati, sukhaṃ paṭibujjhati, na pāpakaṃ supinaṃ passati, manussānaṃ piyo hoti, amanussānaṃ piyo hoti, devatā rakkhanti, n'āssa aggi vā visaṃ vā satthaṃ vā kamati
supinena yathā'pi saṅgataṃ, paṭibuddho puriso na passati, evam'pi piyāyitaṃ janaṃ, petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati.
āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ, no vidahe atho'pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ'ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ, tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā
abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti
aṅgārakās'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. supinak'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

64107.meaning1: like a dream; similar to a dream

examples.text: evam'eva kho, gahapati, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, supinak'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.

aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā… maṃsapes'ūpamā… tiṇ'ukk'ūpamā… aṅgārakās'ūpamā… supinak'ūpamā… yācitak'ūpamā… rukkhaphal'ūpamā… asisūn'ūpamā… sattisūl'ūpamā… sappasir'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
sañcetanikā sukkavissaṭṭhi aññatra supin'antā saṅgh'ādiseso.
m'āyaṃ viya aggato kataṃ, supin'ante'va suvaṇṇapādapaṃ, upagacchasi andha rittakaṃ, janamajjhe'r'iva rupparūpakaṃ.

satta devā, satta mānusā, satta pesācā, satta sarā, satta pavuṭā, satta papātā, satta papātasatāni, satta supinā, satta supinasatāni, cullāsīti mahākappino satasahassāni, yāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti.

64112.meaning1: in full bloom; abounding in blossoms; covered with flowers

examples.text: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya. andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ supupphitasālarukkhamūle aṭṭhāsi.
daharā ca apāpikā c'asi, kiṃ te pabbajjā karissati, nikkhipa kāsāyacīvaraṃ, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.

64113.meaning1: having a flowering crest; with flowers on top

examples.text: supupphit'aggaṃ upagamma bhikkhuni, ekā tuvaṃ tiṭṭhasi sālamūle, na c'atthi te dutiyā vaṇṇadhātu, bāle na tvaṃ bhāyasi dhuttakānan'ti.

64114.meaning1: foot of a sal tree in full bloom

examples.text: sāvatthinidānaṃ. atha kho uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā … aññatarasmiṃ supupphitasālarukkhamūle aṭṭhāsi.
ye, bhikkhave, sattā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, supubb'aṇho, bhikkhave, tesaṃ sattānaṃ.

64116.meaning1: well revered; highly honoured; deeply venerated
64116.meaning2: well worshipped; highly honoured; deeply venerated

examples.text: mātari pitari c'āpi, atho jeṭṭhamhi bhātari, ācariye catutthamhi, tesu na mānaṃ kayirātha, tesu assa sagāravo, ty'assa apacitā assu, ty'assu sādhu supūjitā.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosa-tthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

64120.meaning1: very well-behaved; extremely good; very honest

examples.text: dīgham'āyu manussānaṃ, na naṃ hīḷe suporiso, careyya khīramatto'va, n'atthi maccussa āgamo'ti.

64124.meaning1: easy to support; easy to care for

64125.meaning1: fact of being easy to support; fact of being easy to maintain; fact of low maintenance

examples.text: yehi, bhikkhave, jacc'andhehi hatthissa kaṇṇo diṭṭho ahosi, te evam'āhaṃsu, ediso, deva, hatthī seyyathā'pi suppo'ti.

64127.meaning1: well explained; clearly illustrated; well taught (by)

examples.text: ayaṃ loko paro loko, jānatā suppakāsito, yañ'ca mārena sampattaṃ, appattaṃ yañ'ca maccunā.
ta'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca vitthārikaṃ bāhujaññaṃ puthubhūtaṃ yāva devamanussehi suppakāsitan'ti.

64128.meaning1: extremely bold; very reckless; excessively impudent

examples.text: bhāyāmi nāgadattaṃ suppagabbhaṃ, kulesu vinibaddhaṃ, mā h'eva maccurañño balavato, antakassa vasaṃ upesī'ti.
paricitā'ti samantato citā ācitā upacitā. susamāraddhā'ti suppaguṇakaraṇena suṭṭhu samāraddhā.
gopālo suppagedho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

64133.meaning1: easy to give up; easily abandoned

64134.commentary: (VINa) suppaṭicchannenā'ti na sasīsaṃ pārutena, atha kho gaṇṭhikaṃ paṭimuñcitvā anuvātantena gīvaṃ paṭicchādetvā ubho kaṇṇe samaṃ katvā paṭisaṃharitvā yāva maṇibandhaṃ paṭicchādetvā antaraghare gantabbaṃ. dutiyasikkhāpade, galavāṭakato paṭṭhāya sīsaṃ maṇibandhato paṭṭhāya hatthe piṇḍikamaṃsato ca paṭṭhāya pāde vivaritvā nisīditabbaṃ.

examples.text: suppaṭicchanno antaraghare gamissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.

seyyathā'pi, ānanda, pañc'aṅgikassa tūriyassa suvinītassa suppaṭitāḷitassa sukusalehi samannāhatassa saddo hoti vaggu ca rajanīyo ca khamanīyo ca madanīyo ca, evam'eva kho, ānanda, tāsaṃ tālapantīnaṃ vāt'eritānaṃ saddo ahosi vaggu ca rajanīyo ca khamanīyo ca madanīyo ca.

64137.meaning1: fact of giving up easily; fact of relinquishing quickly; fact of abandoning easily
64137.construction:
su + pati + nī + √sajj > sagg + ī + tā
suppaṭinissaggī + tā

examples.text: sandiṭṭhiparāmāsi-ādhānaggāhi-duppaṭinissaggissa purisapuggalassa asandiṭṭhiparāmāsi-anādhānaggāhi-suppaṭinissaggitā hoti parikkamanāya.

64138.meaning1: giving up easily; relinquishing quickly; abandoning easily
64138.commentary: (MNa) suppaṭinissaggī'ti kiṃ nāma ahaṃ āpanno, kadā āpanno'ti vā tvaṃ āpanno, tava upajjhāyo āpanno'ti vā ekaṃ dve vāre vatvā'pi asukaṃ nāma asukadivase nāma, bhante, āpannattha, saṇikaṃ anussarathā'ti saritvā tāva'd'eva vissajjeti.

examples.text: pare sandiṭṭhiparāmāsī ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī. yam'p'āvuso, bhikkhu asandiṭṭhiparāmāsī hoti, anādhānaggāhī suppaṭinissaggī, ayam'pi dhammo sovacassakaraṇo.

64140.meaning1: gone the right way; practised well

examples.text: ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā… rūpassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā. ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti, suppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ujuppaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, ñāyappaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho, sāmīcippaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho.

64141.meaning1: fact of going the right way; fact of practising well
64141.construction:
su + pati + √pad + na + tā
suppaṭipanna + tā

64142.meaning1: totally subsided; internally calmed; completely settled

examples.text: yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho… abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho, opakkamikā ce'pi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

64143.meaning1: fact of having completely subsided; fact of (something) having completely settled
64143.construction:
su + pati + pa + √sambh + ta + tta
suppaṭippassaddha + tta

examples.text: so kāyaduṭṭhullassa'pi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassa'pi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa'pi suppaṭivinītattā na andh'andhaṃ viya jhāyati. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddh'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.

64144.meaning1: well understood; fully perceived; thoroughly comprehended

examples.text: yesaṃ dhammā suppaṭividitā, paravādesu na nīyare, te sambuddhā samma'd'aññā, caranti visame saman'ti.

64145.commentary: (ANa) diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā'ti atthato ca kāraṇato ca paññāya suṭṭhu paṭividdhā paccakkhaṃ katā.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno paccavekkhaṇānimittaṃ suggahitaṃ hoti sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ paññāya.
tathārūpā'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhātā vacasā paricitā manas'ānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sutadhanaṃ

64146.meaning1: fact of being thoroughly penetrated; fact of being completely understood (by)
64146.construction:
su + pati + √vidh + ta + tta
suppaṭividdha + tta

examples.text: sā hi, rājakumāra, tathāgatassa dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ tathāgataṃ paṭibhātī'ti.

64147.meaning1: thoroughly removed; totally dispelled; completely subdued

examples.text: kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.

64148.meaning1: fact of (something) being thoroughly removed; having been totally dispelled; fact of being completely subdued
64148.construction:
su + pati + vi + √nī + ta + tta
suppaṭivinīta + tta

examples.text: tassa kāyaduṭṭhullam'pi suppaṭippassaddhaṃ hoti, thinamiddham'pi susamūhataṃ hoti, uddhaccakukkuccam'pi suppaṭivinītaṃ hoti. so kāyaduṭṭhullassa'pi suppaṭippassaddhattā thinamiddhassa'pi susamūhatattā uddhaccakukkuccassa'pi suppaṭivinītattā na andh'andhaṃ viya jhāyati.

64149.meaning1: well disposed; properly inclined; well directed
64149.commentary: (MNa) suppaṇihitaṃ me mānasan'ti mayhaṃ cittaṃ suṭṭhu ṭhapitaṃ.

examples.text: so evaṃ pajānāti, n'atthi kho me taṃ pariyuṭṭhānaṃ ajjhattaṃ appahīnaṃ, yen'āhaṃ pariyuṭṭhānena pariyuṭṭhitacitto yathābhūtaṃ nappajāneyyaṃ na passeyyaṃ. suppaṇihitaṃ me mānasaṃ saccānaṃ bodhāyā'ti.

64150.meaning1: easy to pay back; easy to recompense (by)
64150.commentary: (ANa) na suppatikāraṃ vadāmī'ti patikāraṃ kātuṃ na sukaran'ti vadāmi. abhivādan'ādīsu anekasatavāraṃ anekasahassavāram'pi hi pañcapatiṭṭhitena nipatitvā vandanto āsanā vuṭṭhāya paccuggacchanto diṭṭhadiṭṭhakkhaṇe añjaliṃ paggaṇhanto anucchavikaṃ sāmīcikammaṃ karonto divase divase cīvarasataṃ cīvarasahassaṃ piṇḍapātasataṃ piṇḍapātasahassaṃ dadamāno cakkavāḷapariyantena sabbaratanamayaṃ āvāsaṃ karonto sappi-navanīt'ādi-nānappakāraṃ bhesajjaṃ anuppadajjamāno n'eva sakkoti ācariyena katassa patikāraṃ nāma kātun'ti evam'attho veditabbo.

examples.text: yaṃ h'ānanda, puggalo puggalaṃ āgamma buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, imass'ānanda, puggalassa iminā puggalena na suppatikāraṃ vadāmi

64152.meaning1: well established; firmly grounded; firmly planted; fully centred

examples.text: catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharantiyo
sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya.

64153.meaning1: with a mind well established; with a mind fully centred (in)

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacitto, satta bojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ nibbānaṃ abhijāyati.
santi hi, kandaraka, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sekkhā santatasīlā santatavuttino nipakā nipakavuttino, te catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu suppatiṭṭhitacittā viharanti.

64156.meaning1: having firmly grounded feet; first of the thirty-two marks of a great man; (comm) with flat feet
64156.commentary: (MNa) suppatiṭṭhitapādo'ti yathā hi aññesaṃ bhūmiyaṃ pādaṃ ṭhapentānaṃ aggatalaṃ vā paṇhi vā passaṃ vā paṭhamaṃ phusati, vemajjhaṃ vā pana chiddaṃ hoti, ukkhipantānam'pi aggatal'ādīsu ekakoṭṭhāso'va paṭhamaṃ uṭṭhahati, na evaṃ tassa. tassa pana suvaṇṇapādukatalaṃ viya ekappahāren'eva sakalaṃ pādatalaṃ bhūmiṃ phusati, bhūmito uṭṭhahati. tasmā suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo'ti vadati.

examples.text: suppatiṭṭhitapādo kho pana bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

64157.meaning1: fact of having firmly grounded feet
64157.construction:
su + patiṭṭhita + pāda + tā
suppatiṭṭhitapāda + tā
64157.commentary: (DNt) pādānaṃ bhūmiyaṃ samaṃ nikkhipanaṃ, pādatalānaṃ sabbabhāgehi phusanaṃ, samam'eva uddharaṇaṃ, tasmā suṭṭhu samaṃ sabbabhāgehi patiṭṭhitā pādā etassā'ti suppatiṭṭhitapādo, tassa bhāvo suppatiṭṭhitapādatā'ti vuccati lakkhaṇaṃ.

examples.text: kammasarikkhakaṃ nāma daḷhena hutvā katabhāvaṃ sadevako loko jānātū'ti suppatiṭṭhitapāda-mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ. lakkhaṇaṃ nāma suppatiṭṭhitapādatā. lakkhaṇ'ānisaṃso nāma paccatthikehi avikkhambhanīyatā.

64158.meaning1: auspicious mark of having firmly grounded feet

examples.text: vessabhussa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa suppatito nāma rājā pitā ahosi. vassavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.

64160.meaning1: with beautiful banks; with beautiful bathing places

examples.text: ayaṃ, bhante, kakudhā nadī avidūre acch'odakā sāt'odakā sīt'odakā set'odakā suppatitthā ramaṇīyā.
suhutaṃ suyiṭṭhaṃ suppattaṃ, dakkhiṇeyyesu yaṃ kataṃ, yañño ca vipulo hoti, pasīdanti ca devatā.

64163.meaning1: easily overwhelmed; easily overcome; easily knocked over (by)

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yassa kassaci bhikkhuno mettācetovimutti abhāvitā abahulīkatā so suppadhaṃsiyo hoti amanussehi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yāni kānici kulāni bahu'tthikāni appapurisāni tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.

64164.meaning1: well rubbed; well washed; thoroughly cleansed (with)

examples.text: te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, taṃ purisaṃ telena abbhañjitvā sukhumena cuṇṇena tikkhattuṃ suppadhotaṃ karothā'ti.

64167.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pabuddha
64167.construction:
su + pa + √budh + ta + aṃ
suppabuddha + aṃ

examples.text: suppabuddhaṃ pabujjhanti, sadā gotamasāvakā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, niccaṃ buddhagatā sati.

64168.commentary: (ANa) sv'eva divaso katamaṅgalo nāma hoti, ten'assa sadā sumaṅgalan'ti vuccati. pabhātam'pi'ssa sadā suppabhātam'eva, sayanato uṭṭhānam'pi suhuṭṭhitam'eva, khaṇo'pi sukkhaṇo'va, muhutto'pi sumuhutto'va.

examples.text: sunakkhattaṃ sumaṅgalaṃ, suppabhātaṃ suvuṭṭhitaṃ, sukhaṇo sumuhutto ca, suyiṭṭhaṃ brahmacārisu.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo uddhato hoti unnaḷo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākat'indriyo. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo suppameyyo.

64170.meaning1: fully engaged; totally devoted; diligently practising

examples.text: ye suppayuttā manasā daḷhena, nikkāmino gotamasāsanamhi, te pattipattā amataṃ vigayha, laddhā mudhā nibbutiṃ bhuñjamānā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

64172.meaning2: very clear, very pleased, full of faith

examples.text: mettāsinehasiniddhāni pana nayanāni ummīletvā suppasannena mukhena olokanaṃ sammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma. devatthero, tissatthero arogo hotu app'ābādho'ti samannāharaṇaṃ parammukhā mettaṃ manokammaṃ nāma.

64173.meaning1: easy to overturn; easily tipped over; easily knocked over
64173.commentary: (SNa) suppavattiyo'ti suppavattaniyo. yathā icchit'icchitaṃ disaṃ pavattento dhāvati, evaṃ pavattetuṃ sakkā hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kumbho anādhāro suppavattiyo hoti, sādhāro duppavattiyo hoti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, cittaṃ anādhāraṃ suppavattiyaṃ hoti, sādhāraṃ duppavattiyaṃ hotī'ti.
ubhayāni kho pana me pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattīni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso.

64175.meaning1: tightly woven; with the warp well stretched
64175.commentary: (VINa) suppavāyitan'ti suṭṭhu pavāyitaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu samaṃ katvā tante pasāritaṃ.

examples.text: idaṃ kho, āvuso, cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ'ca karotha, vitthatañ'ca, appitañ'ca, suvītañ'ca, suppavāyitañ'ca, suvilekhitañ'ca, suvitacchitañ'ca karotha

64176.meaning1: name of a female lay disciple; foremost laywoman in giving fine things; Suppavāsā Koliyadhītā
64176.construction:
su + pa + √vas > vās + *a + ā
suppavāsa + ā
64176.commentary: (ANa) paṇītadāyikānan'ti paṇītarasadāyikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ, suppavāsā koliyadhītā, aggā'ti dasseti. sā kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbattā satthu dhammadesanaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsikaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde koliyanagare khattiyakule nibbatti, suppavāsā'ti'ssā nāmaṃ akaṃsu. sā vayappattā ekassa sakyakumārassa gehaṃ gatā, paṭhamadassane'y'eva satthu dhammakathaṃ sutvā sot'āpattiphale patiṭṭhāsi. sā aparabhāge sīvaliṃ nāma dārakaṃ vijāyi. tassa vatthu heṭṭhā vitthāritam'eva. (UDa) suppavāsā'ti tassā upāsikāya nāmaṃ.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā.
tena kho pana samayena suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti.

64179.meaning1: well taught; well explained; correctly preached

examples.text: evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye suppavedite niyyānike upasamasaṃvattanike sammāsambuddhappavedite.

64180.meaning1: easily abandoned; easy to renounce; easy to give up

examples.text: satto guhāyaṃ bahun'ābhichanno, tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho, dūre vivekā hi tathāvidho so, kāmā hi loke na hi suppahāyā.

64181.meaning1: thoroughly abandoned; completely dispelled; totally eliminated; completely free (from)
64181.commentary: (THa) t'āmatamadasaṅghasuppahīnā'ti amataṃ vuccati agadaṃ, tena majjantī'ti amatamadā, sappā, tesaṃ saṅgho amatamadasaṅgho, tato suṭṭhu pahīnā apagatā.

examples.text: yo ca n'esaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho, so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho… abhabbā'va te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
t'āmatamadasaṅghasuppahīnā, bhekā mandavatī panādayanti, n'ājja girinadīhi vippavāsasamayo, khemā ajakaraṇī sivā surammā'ti.
tatra su'daṃ suppiyo paribbājako anekapariyāyena buddhassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, dhammassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, saṅghassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati

64185.meaning1: name of the people previously living on Vepulla mountain
64185.construction:
su + √pī > piy + a + ā
suppiya + ā

examples.text: suppiyānaṃ, bhikkhave, manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi. suppiyā, bhikkhave, manussā supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti, dvīhena orohanti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.

64186.meaning1: name of a crow in a Jātaka story
64186.construction:
su + √phus > phass + a + ā
suphassa + ā

examples.text: tassa dohaḷinī bhariyā, suphassā bhakkhitum'icchati, rañño mahānase pakkaṃ, paccagghaṃ rājabhojanaṃ.
atīva saṅgatā'ti ativiya suṭṭhu saṅgatā suphassitā nibbivarā. idañ'ca sippiviracite kittimarathe labbhamānavisesaṃ tattha āropetvā vuttaṃ.

64188.meaning2: blossoming beautifully; with a beautiful flower

64189.meaning1: fully experienced; totally attained; completely realized (by)

examples.text: atthi nissaraṇaṃ loke, paññāya me suphussitaṃ, pamattabandhu pāpima, na tvaṃ jānāsi taṃ padaṃ.

64191.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: dve jālino munino aṭṭhako ca, atha kosallo buddho atho subāhu, upanemiso nemiso santacitto, sacco tatho virajo paṇḍito ca.
tasmiñ'ca dhamme sāvako viharati dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, idam'ahaṃ subījasmiṃ vadāmi. kim'aṅgaṃ pana saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ!

64195.meaning1: fact of being well awakened; fact of having fully understood

examples.text: ye sattasārā anīghā nirāsā, paccekam'ev'ajjhagamuṃ subodhiṃ, tesaṃ visallāna nar'uttamānaṃ, nāmāni me kittayato suṇātha.

64197.commentary: (THa) subbacā'ti vacanakkhamā sovacassakārakehi dhammehi samannāgatā, garūnaṃ anusāsaniyo padakkhiṇaggāhino hothā'ti attho.
64197.notes: A mispelling with -bb- following the pattern of dubbaca.

examples.text: āraññiken'āvuso, bhikkhunā saṅghagatena saṅghe viharantena subbacena bhavitabbaṃ kalyāṇamittena.
purā āgacchate etaṃ, anāgataṃ mahabbhayaṃ, subbacā hotha sakhilā, aññam'aññaṃ sagāravā.

64198.meaning1: easier to instruct; more obedient; more compliant
64198.construction:
su + √vac > bac + a + tara
subbaca + tara

examples.text: tatra ce tumhākaṃ evam'assa, imesaṃ kho āyasmantānaṃ atthato c'eva nānaṃ byañjanato ca nānan'ti, tattha yaṃ bhikkhuṃ subbacataraṃ maññeyyātha so upasaṅkamitvā evam'assa vacanīyo, āyasmantānaṃ kho atthato c'eva nānaṃ, byañjanato ca nānaṃ.

64199.meaning1: well rubbed in circles; properly scoured (with)

examples.text: te tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi, tena hi, bho, tassa purisassa kāyaṃ paṇḍumattikāya tikkhattuṃ subbaṭṭitaṃ ubbaṭṭethā'ti.
